{{Quote|&hellip;and Shaak Ti's the most cunning Jedi I've ever met. She's even taught me a few tricks.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="ROTSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Shaak Ti''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], hailing from the planet [[Shili/Legends|Shili]], serving as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Joining the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] in the years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she took up the ranks of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and was tasked with the oversight of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] training on the ocean world [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].

As a Jedi Councilor, Master Shaak Ti was involved in many epic conflicts during the Clone Wars, including planning and engaging in the opening [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|salvo]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. In addition, Master Ti was instrumental in the [[First Battle of Kamino|First]] and [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Third Battles of Kamino]], where she helped to protect the future generations of clone troopers growing at the facilities, as well as during the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]], where she became one of the few Jedi to survive an encounter with the feared [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Master Ti was known to have dueled and defeated one of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]], [[Artel Darc]], before which she served with distinction during the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)|conflict]] on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].

Shaak Ti was assigned to protect the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in the final days of the war as the threat of the hidden [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] became clear. Stationed there during the initiation of [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], Ti escaped with her life when the Temple and the Republic fell into the hands of the Sith Lords. Fleeing [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and traveling from world to world, Ti finally landed on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] with the orphaned Padawan [[Maris Brood]]. Once on Felucia, Shaak Ti trained Brood and the local [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucians]] for an inevitable confrontation with the Sith. Master Ti was eventually tracked by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] who sent his secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], to kill her. Starkiller and Shaak Ti engaged in a [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|vicious duel]], ending when an injured Ti chose death by falling into the [[Ancient Abyss]].

==Biography==
===Early life and career===
[[File:ShaatTi-SWE.png|thumb|left|150px|Shaak Ti]]
Shaak Ti, like most Jedi of the era, was discovered on her homeworld [[Shili/Legends|Shili]] as an infant when doctors identified her as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Taken to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Ti entered into the [[Jedi academy|academy]] there and spent the next decade studying the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]. After [[Initiate Trials/Legends|graduating]] from the academy, Ti was selected as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to complete her training. After passing her [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] Ti was [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|raised]] to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']] Establishes the typical path of a Jedi Knight, and there are no indications Ti had an abnormal childhood.</ref>

As a Knight Ti pursued the path of the [[Jedi Consular]], strengthening her connection to the Force and working under the [[Council of Reconciliation/Legends|Council of Reconciliation]]. Like many of the Order, Ti was permitted to travel back to her homeworld and connect with her roots. Undergoing a traditional Togrutan right of passage, Ti tracked and killed a wild [[Akul/Legends|Akul]] beast and crafted an [[Akul-tooth headdress|elegant headdress]] from its teeth.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> During her early career Ti took her [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Shaak Ti's first Padawan)|first]] student, choosing to train him on her birth planet, Shili. Amongst the vast, dry scrublands Ti taught her student the ways of the Jedi, eventually raising him to Knighthood. Parting ways, it wasn't long before Shaak Ti got word that he had been killed by a criminal on one of his first missions.<ref name="POTJ" />

Having failed her first student, Ti decided to try again when she chose the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Fe Sun]] as her second apprentice. Once more traveling to Shili and training her student in a slightly unorthodox manner, Ti did not believe in the traditional application of skills through the acceptance of missions from one of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]]. Training Sun to the rank of Knight, Ti suffered the loss of the girl when she was killed by the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] criminal [[Lyshaa]]. While struck by grief, Ti was dedicated to the Jedi way of detachment and allowed herself to come to terms with both her students' deaths. This did not prevent some on the High Council from questioning her methods of training students.<ref name="POTJ" /> Ti took it upon herself to track down Lyshaa and bring her to justice, seeing her imprisoned for countless years on the planet [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].<ref name="JST" />

===Jedi Master===
Eventually, Shaak Ti was recognized by the High Council as a highly trained Jedi and raised her to the rank of Master. As a Master, Ti went on to complete many assignments, gaining great respect from her peers. When High Councilor [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] was killed during an [[Mission to Mawan|incident]] on [[Mawan/Legends|Mawan]] in [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], Master Ti was nominated to the august body to replace the diminutive Master. Accepting the appointment, Ti would contribute her insight to the governing Council for several years.<ref name="Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref>

[[File:ShaakTi-TCW.png|thumb|322x322px|Shaak Ti, Jedi Master.]]
[[24 BBY/Legends|Two years later]], as tensions between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] threatened to split the galaxy in two, the [[Sith cultist/Legends|Sith Cultist]] [[Granta Omega]], Master Yaddle's murderer, reemerged and arranged an assassination plot on [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Along with fellow Councilor [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]] and several other Jedi, Shaak Ti defended the Chancellor, foiling the plot.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref> As the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] continued to gain momentum, Ti issued an official statement from the Temple supporting the actions of Jedi [[Sarrissa Jeng/Legends|Sarrissa Jeng]]'s team on [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]]. The team had attempted to negotiate peace without a standoff but were forced to engage a band of activists after [[Gotal hostage standoff|hostages were taken]].<ref name="Hnn-Gotal Standoff Ends Violently">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|jediwatch/13425_1.html|Gotal Standoff Ends Violently}}</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Ti was stationed on Coruscant when an assassination attempt was made on the life of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] hours before the vital vote on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] that set before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. While the assassination was foiled by the Jedi, the High Council assigned Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to escort her back to her homeworld while Skywalker's master, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], tracked the being who put the hit on the Senator. Shaak Ti occupied the next few days with study and research at the Temple, spending many hours in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple Archives]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
====Battle of Geonosis====
When the High Council was notified that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had been captured and sentenced to death on the desert world [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] rallied all Jedi present at the Temple and rushed to Kenobi's aid. Shaak Ti became one of the nine Jedi Masters to lead the [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]]. Ti and her comrades landed on the dusty plains outside the [[Petranaki arena]] and rushed on foot to storm the structure. Once inside, the Jedi simultaneously ignited their sabers and set to freeing Kenobi, as well as the chained Padawan Skywalker and Senator Amidala. Shaak Ti entered the arena alongside her close friend [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and they remained close together for the remainder of the battle. Fighting through the hundreds of [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], the Jedi who did not fall were herded into a tight circle at the center of the arena. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], offered an ultimatum to Windu and the Jedi: join him, or die. Refusing, the Jedi were prepared to fight to the death when [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived with the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. While deflecting blasterfire, Master Ti boarded a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic gunship]] with fellow Jedi Luminara Unduli, [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and [[Roth-Del Masona]]. Setting the gunship down in the plains outside the arena, Ti and her comrades raced into battle, leading their new soldiers from the front lines.<ref name="AOTC" />

Returning to Coruscant, Ti took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] and began helping coordinate war strategy for the Republic. Ti was known to lead Republic forces against the Separatist horde on many fronts, including during the battles of [[Battle of Centares (Clone Wars)|Centares]] and [[Battle of Ando|Ando]]. Because of the need for more Knights, Master Shaak Ti suggested that the Council forgo the typical Trials of Knighthood and reconstitute the method of war-time promotion; a practice which had not been permitted since the [[New Sith Wars]]. When Jedi Kenobi suggested that his Padawan be promoted, Master Ti joined Masters [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] and [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] in their hesitancy, proposing that Skywalker face the [[Jedi Trials/Legends#Trial of the Spirit|Trial of the Spirit]] before being knighted. When Skywalker completed the Council's test, Ti met with her fellow Councilors in the [[Hall of Knighthood/Legends|Hall of Knighthood]] to raise the boy to the ranks of Knight.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 21">{{CW|21}}</ref> Two months into the war, Master Ti accompanied Grand Master Yoda in an [[Battle of unidentified planet (Yoda's charge)|assault]] on a distant world. While Master [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] led an aerial assault with the [[Sons and Daughters of Freedom]], Ti joined another Jedi Knight in taking the planet in the name of the Republic.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 1">{{CW|1}}</ref>

====Duties on Kamino====
{{Quote|We haven't lost yet, Lama Su. While Jedi still breathe, we will not abandon Kamino.|Jedi Master Shaak Ti speaking to Kamino's Prime Minister Lama Su on [[First Battle of Kamino|defending]] Kamino|<ref name="Republic 50">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref>}}
As the war began to gain momentum, the Jedi High Council decided to dispatch one of their own, Master Shaak Ti, to safeguard the clone production facilities and oversee the training of the [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] training there. Serving as adviser to [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]], Ti worked with the [[Cuy'val Dar]] trainers at [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] to administer the tests that each clone squad had to pass before they saw battle. One squad in particular, [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]], seemed to lack what it took to ever see battle, disappointing even their teachers. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Bric/Legends|Bric]] deemed them a failure; hunter [[El-Les/Legends|El-Les]] wanted to be sympathetic. Shaak Ti initially failed the group, but after giving them some motivational advice, the four clones passed their final test and were deployed.<ref name="Clone Cadets">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref>

[[File:ShaakTiTCW-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|Shaak Ti helped defend Kamino from multiple Separatist attacks]]
Not long after Master Ti was notified of a potential Separatist attack on the cloning facilities. Reinforced by Master [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]]' battle group and several Jedi Knights, Ti joined Prime Minister Su in the Tipoca City command center to coordinate the defense of the facilities. As the CIS Commander [[Merai]] began the [[First Battle of Kamino|battle]], Jedi defended the facility from the skies over the vast oceans of Kamino. When the Separatists broke through and began landing troops in the city, Ti began to order the evacuation of the adolescent clones. In desperation, Su opted to activated the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]], ARC troopers who had remained in [[stasis tube]]s since the beginning of the war. Fighting alongside the ARCs, Ti made her way to the laboratory housing the third generation of fetal clones with trooper [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|A-17]]. Chased by dozens of battle droids, Ti and the trooper were joined by Jedi Kenobi and Skywalker, both following along as the team crossed the narrow [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] connector-bridge that attached to the underwater lab. Prepared to destroy the fetal clones to avoid them falling into the hands of the CIS, A-17 eventually accepted the Jedi's plan of destroying the bridge to the lab until help could arrive. With the bridge and the droids destroyed, Ti used the Force to plug the hole and keep the ocean at bay, waiting out the rest of the battle until help could rescue her and her comrades.<ref name="Republic 50" />

It wasn't long before the Separatists planned another [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|strike]] at Kamino, this time led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], two of the highest ranking members in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. Reinforced once more by Jedi Generals Kenobi and Skywalker, Ti and Su coordinated the defenses until aqua droids breached the control center. As Skywalker and Kenobi engaged Ventress and Grievous respectively, Shaak Ti led clones against the droid army and was successful in repelling them from the planet once again. Despite a few more smaller attempts, Shaak Ti's strategy proved successful in preventing another full-scale assault on the planet throughout the rest of the war.<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>

====Battle of Hypori====
{{Main|Battle of Hypori/Legends}}
{{Quote|Never have we been outmaneuvered by droids. His strategy is without flaw.|Shaak Ti, referring to Separatist General Grievous|audio=NeverOutmaneuveredByDroids-CW20.flac|<ref name="CW20">{{CW|20}}</ref>}}
[[File:Grievous-Attacks-Ki-Adi-Mundi-And-Shaak-Ti.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Shaak Ti and Ki Adi Mundi duel Grievous.]]
When Master [[Daakman Barrek]] reported intelligence he had gathered on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] to the High Council, a task force was dispatched to take the large droid factory Barrek had discovered offline. The task force, consisting of Councilors Shaak Ti and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], along with Jedi [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[K'Kruhk]], and [[Tarr Seirr]], joined with Barrek and his Padawan, [[Sha'a Gi]], in leading a ground assault on the planet. Out-maneuvered by droids, the Jedi's clone army was defeated, with reinforcements being destroyed as soon as they emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Rushing for the shelter provided by the wreckage of a downed [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], Barrek covered his fellow Jedi and engaged the leader of the droid army in the process: General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="CW20" />

[[File:Shaak_ki_hypori.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Shaak Ti, wounded after her duel with Grievous.]]
The six remaining [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were left surrounded by the hordes of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] produced by the factory. As the Jedi prepared for the inevitable standoff, Grievous dove down from above, making the clearing amidst the wreckage his arena. Engaging the cyborg, the Jedi were defeated one by one; Padawan Gi ran out to face Grievous, quickly leading to his death, Jedi Sierr's head was crushed under the cyborg's heavy [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] talons, while K'Kruhk was left for dead after a seemingly mortal blow from one of the General's two lightsabers. Secura was easily batted aside during the fighting, with Ti and Mundi holding their own the longest. While using her [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] abilities to distract Grievous, Ti was caught off guard by revealing his second pair of limbs, sending the Togruta Jedi hurtling into a pile of debris.<ref name="CW20" />

With Mundi the last Jedi standing, the Cerean began to fence with the General, but was rescued by a group of ARC troopers aboard a LAAT/i gunship. Outgunned, Grievous retreated, allowing the troopers to load up the dead and injured Jedi and retreat back to Coruscant.<ref name="CW20" />

====Battle of Brentaal IV====
{{Main|Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)}}
[[File:Battle_of_Brentaal.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Shaak Ti in battle.]]
Five months into the war, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had received information that a Separatist stronghold would be lying dormant for a few weeks, opening a window of opportunity for a decisive strike to cripple the fortress of a potentially secessionist planet. Because this planet, [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], was a vital link in the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] connecting the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], the Republic dispatched a large task force to hold the planet and overthrow General [[Shogar Tok]] on the planet's surface.<ref name="JST" />

Leading the mission from orbit, Master Plo Koon coordinated Masters Ti, [[Shon Kon Ray]] and Agen Kolar on the ground. Leading three separate groups up to the fortress in a massive assault, each team was met with heavy resistance, suffering substantial casualties including Master Ray. Rallying her remaining troops for a final push towards the fortress, Master Ti charged into the structure to find many freshly killed beings. As she and her surviving troops surveyed the building they discovered it was truly a prison, and a recent uprising left many of its prisoners and guards dead. After a brief fight with a group of prisoners, Ti managed to convince them to aid her in destroying the facility in exchange for their freedom. The small band of outlaws consisted of renegade [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] [[Sagoro Autem]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Ryyk (Wookiee)|Ryyk]], undercover Jedi [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], and [[Lyshaa]], the Zeltron responsible for Padawan Fe Sun's death. Putting aside her dislike of Lyshaa, Ti decided to split the group into three parts; She and Lyshaa would search the facility for General Tok, Vos and Autem would disable the weapons system, and the lone clone trooper would take out the shield generator alone. Once all was said and done, Ti planned for Master Koon to execute a bombing run on the structure and decimate the Separatist army surrounding it.<ref name="JST" />

[[File:Shaaktievadesblaster.jpg|thumb|left|Shaak Ti evades blaster fire on Brentaal IV.]]
Setting out to find Tok, Ti refused to be goaded into a confrontation with Lyshaa; instead, the Jedi convinced the Zeltron to use her innate ability to manipulate pheromones in order to distract Shogar Tok long enough for Ti to arrest him. While the pair searched for the elusive warlord, Tok had in fact captured Master Kolar and was in the process of interrogating him before the holoimage of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Kolar falsely informed the Count that Ti had in fact perished in the fighting; however the Sith Lord did not believe these claims and ordered Tok to find the Togruta's body. Heading back to his private chambers, Tok encountered the Zeltron bounty hunter in his sleeping chambers. Lulled by her power over emotions, Lyshaa seduced him into bed while Ti maneuvered herself to arrest the warlord. Before Ti could do so, Lyshaa betrayed the Jedi and warned Tok of the threat. Blasting Ti in the chest, the pair left her for dead and continued to make their way for the bed.<ref name="JST" />

[[File:TheDeathofShogarTok.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Shaak Ti kills [[Shogar Tok]].]]
Slowing her metabolism so she could quickly [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] herself, Ti sensed the other two teams destroy both the weapons and shielding equipment in the levels below her. With Lyshaa and Tok distracted, Master Ti sprung up and slew Tok after a brief but fierce firefight. Not trusting Ti's promise of mercy, Lyshaa ran for her life, only to activate a hidden [[lightstorm]] chamber. The room filled with beams of coherent light, eviscerating Lyshaa's body, killing her. With Tok dead and the fortress disabled and vulnerable, Shaak Ti rendezvous with her comrades and was shuttled back to the [[Halls of Healing]] on Coruscant.<ref name="JST" />

====Battle of Dagu====
{{Main|Battle of Dagu}}
[[File:EscapeFromDagu-cover.jpg|thumb|left|417x417px|Shaak Ti on Dagu.]]
Four months later, Master Ti was accompanying a large group of clones when they were captured and imprisoned on the swamp world, [[Dagu]]. While one of Count Dooku's most cunning [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] Acolytes, [[Artel Darc]], controlled the Separatist prison, Shaak Ti was able to disguise her identity as a Jedi and laid low amongst her fellow prisoners. In the depths of the prison, Ti began a [[Battle of Dagu|revolt]] against the Separatists, aided by clones and the enslaved natives, the [[Rybet/Legends|Rybet]]. As the clones overthrew their droid captors, Shaak Ti engaged Artel Darc in battle, eventually striking him down and freeing the prisoners.

====Year Two====
As the war entered into its second year, General Ti led a group of clones in engaging a squadron of [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] over an uncharted world. Loosing at least one LAAT/i gunships, Ti was forced to withdraw, unable to search for survivors. Indeed at least one trooper survived the crash, [[Able|Clone Trooper-1707]], a trooper who would survive in the forests of the world through the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Star Wars: Empire: General Skywalker">''[[Star Wars: Empire: "General" Skywalker]]''</ref>

Master Ti received special honors for her efforts in the war from the Supreme Chancellor. Among these medals and awards was a grove of [[ch'hala tree]]s, a gift which she in turned gave to the Jedi Temple for placement in one of its vast hallways.<ref name="Star Wars Insider 66">[[Star Wars Insider 66|''Star Wars Insider'' 66]]</ref>

====Imprisonment on Metalorn====
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Shaak Ti was captured by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and transported to a maximum security prison facility in [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn's]] [[Unreal City/Legends|Unreal City]]. The facility's lone prisoner, it was guarded by soldiers of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] and overseen by [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] Foreman [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]]. Once the head of the [[Republic Security Committee]], [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], discovered Ti's situation, he contacted Foreman Tambor, citing interest in applying Metalorn's infrastructure template to his homeworld. Meeting with Organa and his aides on Metalorn, Tambor began giving the Viceroy a tour of the planet, including the prison. Locating Ti's cell, Organa [[Mission to Metalorn (Bail Organa)|managed]] to pass along her lightsaber so that she could free herself. Outside her cell, Ti was able to protect Organa and escape to the landing platform where the Viceroy's ship, the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] lay waiting.<ref name="Bailed Out">{{CWACite|5|Bailed Out}}</ref>

====Jedi Temple Bombing====
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a hangar in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was subjected to a terrorist bombing that took the lives of six Jedi as well as numerous clone and civilian hangar workers, causing Shaak Ti to return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to deliberate the situation. Since the Council suspected that the culprit could have been anyone in the Temple at the time, the investigation fell to Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano, who had been outside the Temple and so were absolved of suspicion and biased judgment. Their investigation led them to Jackar Bowmani, which they reported to the Council (including Ti's holographic presence), who ordered them to search Jackar's home. This led them in turn to Jackar's widow, Letta Turmond, who confessed to the crime. Shaak Ti later attended the funeral of the Jedi who died in the bombing and listened to Master Yoda's eulogy with a solemn expression on her face, suggesting she was close to one or more of the deceased. When the ceremony was over, she left the room with Master Tera Sinube and later attended a meeting in the war room to discuss troop movements, which was interrupted by Admiral Wilhuff Tarkin with a request from Turmond for Ahsoka Tano's presence. Turmond later died when a mysterious person Force-choked her, and Tano was blamed for the crime. Tarkin contacted the Council with his belief that Tano was guilty, accusing her of sedition which provoked a shocked reaction from several Council members, including Ti. To further complicate matters and miniaturize the Jedi's authority, Tarkin demanded on behalf of the Senate that Tano be expelled from the Order and tried by the military courts, dismissing the Jedi traditions and opinions. Though the august body was divided, the Council's senior members acquiesced to the request and expelled Tano; though Ti witnessed the judgment, it was not clear if she agreed to the expulsion. Though the real culprit was later revealed, Tano chose not to return to the Order and left the Temple.

====Clone trooper conspiracy====
[[File:ShaakTiConfrontsFives-Fugitive.png|left|thumb|250x250px|Shaak Ti confronts [[Fives/Legends|Fives]].]]
Later in the war, Shaak Ti presided over the arrival of clone trooper Tup on Kamino for a medical examination. During the Battle of Ringo Vinda, Tup had repeatedly slipped into a trance before inexplicably murdering Jedi Master Tiplar in the heat of battle and later trying to attack her sister Tiplee. Shaak Ti assured Tup's friends that he would be fine, but the clone later died on the operating table. The cause of his death and malfunction was discovered to be an inhibitor chip in his brain, prompting further investigation. ARC-5555, or Fives, had his own chip removed and both were taken to Coruscant. Once there, however, Fives apparently went berserk and attacked Chancellor Palpatine before fleeing into the underworld, closely pursued by Shaak Ti. The whole incident was explained as a parasite having corrupted the chips, but Ti was left unaware that the chips were part of a plot that would see the near-total destruction of the Jedi Order.

====Battle of Coruscant====
{{Quote|I failed&hellip;|Shaak Ti laments over the capture of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to Mace Windu|<ref name="CW25">{{CW|25}}</ref>}}
[[File:RailwayDuel.jpg|thumb|250x250px|Shaak Ti fights a [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuard]] in a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Hovertrain/Legends|mag-lev train]] station.]]
Not long after being freed from Metalorn, Ti was stationed on Coruscant as the High Council obtained more and more leads regarding the existence of the mysterious "second [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]," [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. When [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|SBI agents]] traced information to the abandoned industrial sector known as [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] on Coruscant, Ti accompanied a group of ARC troopers and Master Mace Windu to the abandoned [[LiMerge Building/Legends|LiMerge building]] and separated into [[Aurek Team|Teams Aurek]] and [[Bacta Team|Bacta]] to search the network of tunnels covering the planet's surface. After a mass search, the SBI agents discovered that one tunnel led directly into the subbasement of [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]], a massive residence tower home to many Senators and the Supreme Chancellor. As they raced to the Tower, a massive Separatist fleet appeared in Coruscant's orbit, forcing Windu and Ti to withdraw from the search. While Windu traveled to the Temple to coordinate the counter assault, Ti was dispatched to protect the Chancellor. Meeting up with Master [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]], the Jedi searched the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] and the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] for Palpatine with no success. As the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|massive battle]] increased in intensity in the skies of Coruscant, the Senate was in the process of evacuating. Drilling several Senators for information on the Chancellor's location, the two Jedi were directed back to 500 Republica. In the Chancellor's chambers, Ti and Allie joined with fellow Masters [[Foul Moudama]], [[Roron Corobb/Legends|Roron Corobb]], [[Roth-Del Masona]], and [[B'ink Utrila]] in demanding that the Chancellor evacuate to the [[Quadrant H-46|Sah'c District]] shelters. As he lectured the Jedi and his advisers on his symbolic importance to the Republic and his ensured safety because of his position, General Grievous and several [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]] infiltrated the suite and attempted to capture the Republic's leader.<ref name="LOE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

Fleeing the room with the Chancellor while clone troops and senate guards stalled Grievous, the Jedi descended through the Tower, reaching the lower level [[Train/Legends|mag-train]] [[Train station/Legends|station]] where they joined up with Masters Windu and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. Safely on board with the Chancellor, Windu and Fisto were able to destroy the MagnaGuards and dislodge Grievous from the train. Grievous was not destroyed, however, commandeering a Republic gunship to chase down the train. The Jedi, believing themselves to be in the clear, arrived at the bunker's turbolift station and bid Masters Windu and Fisto farewell. While the four Jedi protectors escorted the Chancellor to the bunker,<ref name="LOE" /> Ti stayed behind in the tunnel to hold off dozens of oncoming MagnaGuards.<ref name="CW25" />

Shaak Ti attempted to defend herself against the Magna Guards, but was sliced in the hand by a MagnaGuard, dropping her lightsaber well out of reach. She had no time to use the force and pull it over to her, since the Magna Guards continued to attack, so instead she stole an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]] from a MagnaGuard, and wielded it as a Bo-staff. Blocking the MagnaGuards' attacks, she managed to retrieve her lightsaber back and use both weapons at the same time. She destroyed many of them with her weapons, but it was when they stopped attacking her that she realized she had made a mistake, and the MagnaGuards were merely a distraction.<ref name="CW25" />

As Moudama, Masona, Utrila, and Corobb escorted the Chancellor down the lift, Ti and Allie were forced to stay behind to engage the newly caught-up Grievous. Opening fire on the Jedi, the Kaleesh General cut down the clone escort and bypassed the unconscious Jedi. Descending into the bunker, Grievous slaughtered the Chancellor's four Jedi bodyguards and captured the man, retreating with his prize back to his ship.<ref name="LOE" />

A battle-weary Ti confronted Grievous as he fled, but was too weak to defeat him. After a brief bout, she was quickly subdued. Gripping her by the throat and arms Grievous took her lightsaber as a trophy and trussed the Togruta in a stun-net so that she could tell anyone who found her what had happened.<ref name="CW25" /> When Windu and Fisto discovered the dead Jedi and heard Ti's tale, they sent her back to the Temple to recover as they chased Grievous into space.<ref name="LOE" />

====Close to the end of the war====
{{Quote|Anakin, should your place not be here, to help with our forces, if Palpatine retaliates?|Shaak Ti, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="ROTSn" />}}
After her recovery, Shaak Ti was able to sit in on the meeting of the High Council that saw the acceptance of Jedi Skywalker's appointment to the august body to replace [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]]. Over the course of several days, the Council decided it was time to remove the Chancellor from office; as both Grievous and Count Dooku had been killed. As Master Windu left the Temple with three other Council members, Ti was appointed to join [[Jedi Gate Master|Gatemaster]] [[Jurokk]] in the defense of the ancient edifice and the children living within. As all senior Padawans and Knights were armed and the Temple secured, Ti took to meditating outside the entry door to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] in the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]]. Interrupting her trance, Jedi Skywalker demanded that she let him pass into the hangars so that he could travel to the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's office]]. Believing that he intended to help Windu defeat the Sith, Ti let him pass before retiring to her [[Shaak Ti's quarters|quarters]]. Within the next hour, Ti felt a terrible shudder in the Force and began to prepare for an assault by the Sith.<ref name="ROTSn" />

====Defending the Jedi Temple====
Unknown to Shaak Ti, Mace Windu, Kit Fisto, Saesee Tiin and Agen Kolar had been killed by Darth Sidious and Anakin had been seduced to the dark side of the force by Sidious and had become Darth Vader. As the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], led by Darth Vader, descended on the Temple,<ref name=":0">{{Film|III}}</ref> Ti rallied her fellow Jedi in an attempt to repulse the Sith Lord and his troops. While fighting valiantly alongside her peers and even fending off the newly christened Vader himself, Ti quickly realized that she could not prevent the fall of the Temple. Rushing to the hangars, the Councilor began a mass evacuation. Aided by [[Temple employee]]s and other Jedi, Ti ensured that many Initiates, Padawans, Knights, and Masters made their way into the bowels of Coruscant before she reluctantly made her own escape.<ref name="The Force Unleashed Databank">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed#The Force Unleashed Databank|''The Force Unleashed Databank'']]</ref>

===Great Jedi Purge and Exile on Felucia===
{{Quote|Vader's assassin&hellip; Are you prepared to meet your fate?|Shaak Ti|audio=VadersAssassinMeetFate-TFU.flac|<ref name="TFU" />}}
[[File:Shaak_Ti_Felucia_exile.jpg|thumb|left|354x354px|Shaak Ti in exile on Felucia.]]
Fleeing Coruscant, Shaak Ti wandered the galaxy in search of survivors of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="The Force Unleashed Databank" /> Shaak Ti had become one of the last known members of the Jedi High Council to survive the order, the only others being [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and&mdash;technically&mdash;[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as Darth Vader.<ref name=":0" /> Ti stumbled upon the orphaned Padawan [[Maris Brood]]<ref name="The Force Unleashed Databank" /> attempting to avenge her master's death by confronting Darth Vader<ref name="The Force Unleashed Databank" />. She was initially reluctant to take Maris as an apprentice as she had already trained two apprentices in her career and watched both fall victim to criminal killers shortly before their graduation to knighthood. However, Ti sensed that the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] woman was dangerously close to succumbing to the dark side due to her hatred for Vader<ref name="TFU" /> and encouraged Brood to join her in exile<ref name="The Force Unleashed Databank" /> so that together they could heal and carry on the Jedi traditions in solitude. They ultimately settled on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]],<ref name="TFU" /> where [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] were shot down,<ref name=":0" /><ref name="Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 4">[[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 4|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> and made contact with the native [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucians]]. Ti dedicated her time to teaching the Felucians to control their burgeoning abilities and resist the dark side. She eventually became a respected chieftain, commanding multiple tribes of natives. She also honed their ability to use the Force for attack and defense with the hopes that they could help protect Maris and eventually aid a reborn Jedi Order.<ref name="The Force Unleashed Databank" /> Ti continued to train both Maris and the natives in the ways of the light side of the Force so as to preserve the teachings of the Jedi Order and prepare for an unavoidable confrontation with the Sith.<ref name="TFU" />

After years of leadership on Felucia, Ti finally saw that the time for training was over: Darth Vader had [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|dispatched]] his apprentice [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] to kill her and overthrow her control of Felucia. Warning her people that the time had come to confront the Sith, a party of Jungle Felucians ambushed Starkiller as he touched down on the planet, slowing him down as he mowed through their villages in search of Ti. As the assassin approached on foot, Ti sent Brood into the wilderness to hide, wary of the influence of the dark side on the girl. Riding on the shoulders of an elder [[Shaak Ti's rancor|rancor]], Ti made her way to the [[Ancient Abyss]], a place of sacrifice for the Jungle Felucians for many millennia. Waiting in meditation as the assassin drew closer, Ti stood to solemnly confront the boy, saddened by Vader's manipulation of him.<ref name="TFU" />

====Duel with the Sith====
{{Quote|Poor boy. The Sith ''always'' betray one another. But I'm sure you'll learn that soon enough.|Shaak Ti to Starkiller, and her last words|audio=PoorBoy-TFU.flac|<ref name="TFU" />}}
[[File:ShaakTi_vs_Starkiller.jpg|thumb|250x250px|Shaak Ti in combat against Marek, [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].]]
When Starkiller entered the Ancient Abyss, Ti stood her ground and welcomed the boy as the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] that lived in the heart of the Abyss drew her rancor into its maw. Shaak Ti and the assassin engaged each other first with a test of their respective Force abilities. Batting aside each of the Sith's [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] attacks with ease, Ti attacked him using swift strikes with her lightsaber. Using the Force to cause the Sith to fall to the ground, Ti called upon her people to attack the boy while he was vulnerable. Defeating the warriors one-by-one, Starkiller was lured by Ti deeper into the Abyss.<ref name="TFU" />

Shaak Ti's mastery over the sarlacc became evident as she commanded it to slam its massive tentacles down around Starkiller. As their lightsaber duel intensified, Starkiller was having difficulty keeping up with the Master Jedi's strikes, barely countering them. Throughout their duel, Shaak Ti told the boy that Vader was only using him and he should turn to the light side of the force. As their duel took them into the tentacles of the sarlacc, Starkiller was forced off as the sarlacc attacked him. While he was on the ground, Ti ran along a tentacle, intent on killing the assassin. However, Starkiller turned around at the last minute, catching Ti off balance and ravaging her body with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. He then electrified the tentacles of the sarlacc which flung Shaak Ti high into the air. Falling hard to the ground, a mortally injured Ti began to utter prophecy, foretelling that Starkiller would be betrayed by his Sith masters should he remain on his current path. Following her utterance of the prophecy, Ti purposefully flung herself into the mighty sarlacc's pit, her body engulfed by a blinding blue light.<ref name="TFU" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Maris, we are among the last of the Jedi. While we live, the order survives. I cannot allow you to be captured or killed by the Empire.|Shaak Ti's last words to Maris Brood|<ref name="TFU" />}}
With Shaak Ti dead, the environment of Felucia slipped swiftly into darkness. Holding back the dark side for so long, the dam broke as she died, plunging the Felucians and their shamans into madness. The flora and fauna of the world became more hostile, aggressive, and twisted by the dark side. Maris Brood was not able to help keep the world stable as she was seduced by anger and fell into a crazed mania, losing herself in the jungle. When Starkiller was betrayed by his master as Ti's prophecy forewarned, he began to seek out answers to his many questions. Meanwhile, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Bail Organa sought out Ti for aid in rescuing his daughter, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Arriving on the planet, Organa was captured by Brood and taken to an abandoned Felucian village where she was determined to hold him as ransom against the Imperials. Starkiller arrived to confront Brood soon after, sparing her life out of pity and regret for killing Shaak Ti.<ref name="TFU" />

Shortly before her death, on the junk world of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], Ti's former colleague [[Kazdan Paratus]] had descended into insanity. Crafting a [[Junk Temple|massive replica]] of the Coruscant Jedi Temple out of junk, Paratus built a junk puppet of the entire High Council, including the still living Master Ti. When Starkiller was sent to kill the Jedi droid maker, the puppet was defeated after a brief encounter with the Sith assassin. Again on Raxus Prime, a year following her death, the training droid [[PROXY]] holographically took her form in a duel against his master.<ref name="TFU" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Shaak Ti was unique.|[[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]|<ref name="TFUn" />}}
[[File:ShaakTiFinal.jpg|thumb|left|250x250px|Shaak Ti given special recognition by Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].]]
A powerful Togruta female, Master Shaak Ti's nature was notably different from her heritage at times. Though Togruta were a communal species, Ti was highly independent and preferred to operate alone. To this end, Master Ti's training methods differed from the standard procedures of the Order, taking her students to her homeworld for training in seclusion. While the High Council permitted this method, both of Ti's Padawan suffered from their lack of experience, dying not long after they were knighted. With a subtle sense of humor, Master Ti sometimes seemed cold and unfeeling; something that was not helped by her naturally pointed teeth which, when bared, appeared as a sinister snarl. Naturally patterned to blend into the wilds of [[Shili/Legends|Shili]], Shaak Ti was capable of sneaking up behind an opponent or adversary and catching them unawares.<ref name="POTJ" />

Despite being trained as a [[Jedi Consular]], Ti's reputation with a lightsaber was well known throughout the Order. Regardless of her reputation, Ti remained humble and preferred to spar with words rather than her lightsaber. Reflective and contemplative, Ti was deeply troubled throughout the Clone Wars, as she was unable to properly reflect on the Order's place in the conflict. Indeed, while a member of the High Council, Ti was often quiet, reflecting on the words of her peers and occasionally interjecting a few soft words into the discussion. On the matter of Anakin Skywalker, Ti was in the minority when she voiced doubt in the young Human's nature and his readiness to be a Knight. She was thus overruled by the other Masters, though she held close to her opinion.<ref name="POTJ" />
When the war was ended and the Republic and the Jedi Order collapsed at the feet of the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Ti exiled herself, fading away amongst the stars and biding her time until she could act out against the Sith. Remaining active in her role of peacekeeper, Master Ti resided on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] as [[Felucian Chieftain|Chieftain]] of the [[Felucian/Legends|Felucians]] and guardian of the distraught Padawan [[Maris Brood]]. For nearly two decades Ti trained the Felucians and tempered their dark side nature. Training them to repel the Empire, Ti believed that her destiny had not yet been fulfilled, and that only the guidance of the Force, not her own desire to strike back at the Empire, was the true path to success.<ref name="TFU" />

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:ShaakTiLightsaber-FF74.png|thumb|right|250px|Shaak Ti's lightsaber]]
Regarded as a Master of legendary power and strength in the Force as well as among the finest and most cunning swordsmen of her time, Shaak Ti, despite her humbleness and preference on studying the fields of diplomacy and [[Force healing/Legends|healing]],<ref name="POTJ" /> was an extremely powerful and accomplished master of the Force and exceptional lightsaber duelist.

[[File:ShaakTi_tfu.jpg|thumb|left|402x402px|Shaak Ti in [[Form II/Legends|Makashi's]] opening stance.]]
Well-trained and skilled in all forms of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], Ti was particularly accomplished in the use of both the [[Form II/Legends|Makashi]] and [[Form IV/Legends|Ataru]] forms.<ref name="TFUn" /><ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref><ref name="CWA game">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref> Highly well-regarded for her tremendous grace, which was further amplified by her exotic pigmentation and coloring, Ti's skills were even compared to that of Count Dooku.<ref name="ROTSn" /> Combined with her mastery of Forms II and IV, Ti was effortlessly capable of launching swift barrages of saber strikes while traversing around the battlefield gracefully, as displayed by how she pressured Marek's usage of Soresu while leaving barely any openings to counter, forcing the apprentice to use the Force to best her.<ref name="TFUn" /><ref name="TFU" /> She was also well-versed in dual-blade combat, making effective use of both her lightsaber and an electrostaff in an improvised form of [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] to defeat all the Magnaguards she faced during the Battle of Coruscant.<ref name="CW25" /> Infusing her weapon with the Force, she would throw her enemy off their feet by plunging her sabers into the ground and sending Force tremors through the soil.<ref name="TFU" /> Easily fighting in crowds, Ti was aided in clearly perceiving her surroundings by the hollow spaces in her cranial horns, or [[Montral/Legends|montrals]]. Gathering information ultrasonically, they allowed her to speed up her movements faster and with more accuracy than most other Jedi.<ref name="DB" />

One of Ti's greatest gifts was her ability to commune with nature more deeply then most Jedi of the era. Particularly accomplished in the art of [[Animal bond|controlling fauna]] and direct them with her will, which she combined with equally potent mastery of the [[Plant Surge|''Consitor Sato'']] technique, her mastery of both techniques of controlling the sentient aspects of nature were so great that she could command the entire flora and fauna of Felucia when fighting Marek and was able to easily stop the Sarlacc from devouring her and command it to attack Marek. In addition, Ti was capable of [[Alter Environment|altering the environment]] to cause thick fogs, blast away enemies with powerful whirlwinds, and freeze the surfaces of water bodies. .<ref name="TFU" /> Shaak Ti was capable of using [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] and would use it in conjunction with the environment against her foes.<ref name="LOE" /> Her mastery of Telekinesis was even praised by Plo Koon, himself described as a "telekinetic savant", and proved capable of moving large objects without even using hand gestures or looking in their direction and even while exhausted, flinging large objects at extremely high velocities with simple hand gestures. She was able to easily deflect the telekinetic assault of Galen Marek. Proficient in the use of [[Force barrier/Legends|Force Barriers]], Shaak Ti could hold back a flood on Tipoca City on Kamino and create a shield strong enough to repel the efforts of Marek despite his extreme power and skill in the Force. She could also use [[Tutaminis]] proficiently, as she not only deflected blows from Electrostaffs but even repelled a glancing lightsaber blow. Shaak Ti was able to concentrate [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]] into a powerful attack she could throw at foes.<ref name="TFUc">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''The Force Unleashed'' comic]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===Portrayal===
[[File:ShaakTiFinalTouches.jpg|thumb|left|369x369px|Maria Brill as Shaak Ti.]]
Shaak Ti's appearance was derived from concept art by artists [[Dermot Power]] and [[Iain McCaig]], who designed her as a Jedi for use in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="DB" /> Her name is shared with an in-universe beast native to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>

Given life by the Israeli [[Orli Shoshan]], she had no spoken lines but posed for promotional pictures which appeared on action figures and in guidebooks. Shoshan was asked to reprise her background role as Shaak Ti during the filming of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], though all of her scenes were cut from the finished product. Once again though, promotional images were taken with slight differences in her make-up, and used in guidebooks and on other products.<ref name="DB" /> Shaak Ti did appear in ''Revenge of the Sith'' though, portrayed in [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] form by [[Maria Brill]].<ref name=":0" />

The character was voiced by [[Grey Griffin|Grey DeLisle]] in the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' 2D-animated series,<ref name="CW20" /><ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 21" /> by [[Tasia Valenza]] in the 2008 [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Clone Wars'' TV series]] (as "very calm" and "subdued" with a "Spanish flavor, maybe something on the Brazilian side"<ref name="SWArchive-Voicing Shaak Ti: Tasia Valenza">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/tasia_valenza/index.html|text=Voicing Shaak Ti: Tasia Valenza}}</ref>), and by [[Susan Eisenberg]] in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''<ref name="TFU" /> while model [[Mia Kelly]] was used to form the character's game model.

===Unused death scenes===
{{Quote|A tragic ending of a gallant warrior, no doubt.|[[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]|<ref name="ROTS deleted scenes">{{Film|III}} [[Content cut from Star Wars|deleted scenes]]</ref>}}
[[File:ShaakTiStab.jpg|thumb|250x250px|Shaak Ti dies at the hands of Grievous.]]
Shaak Ti had two different death scenes at various stages of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]{{'s}} development, but they were both deleted, and it was confirmed by [[Star Wars Insider 87|''Star Wars Insider'' 87]] that neither scene was [[canon]]ical,<ref name="Star Wars Insider 87">[[Star Wars Insider 87|''Star Wars Insider'' 87]]</ref> and that she was still alive at the end of ''Revenge of the Sith'' as Shaak Ti is later seen alive in hologram form during a Jedi Council meeting.<ref name=":0" /> This was later reinforced by her appearance in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''.<ref name="DB" />

The first version of her death was leaked to many Star Wars fan sites and described in the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article "Into The Fuel Chamber" and the book ''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''.<ref name="The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> In various forms of this scene, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] ignited a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] through her heart on the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] with Anakin Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] looking on. This was [[George Lucas]]' original idea, and appeared in storyboards and early drafts of the screenplay. In fact, this scene was completed and included on the DVD release of ''Revenge of the Sith'', but is to be regarded as non-canon. When it was planned for her to die aboard the ''Invisible Hand'', her seat on the Council was going to be given to [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]], an [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] Jedi.<ref name="DB" /> Originally the ''Revenge of the Sith'' Shaak Ti action figure had a hole in its chest all the way through its back, to reflect this death; in the final released version it was filled in. When George Lucas cut the scene, artists at [[Cartoon Network]] thought to explain her absence from the start of the film by having her die in at Grievous' hands in the Clone Wars Micro Series.<ref name="Hyperspace-Episode III Set Diary - The Cruel Fate of Shaak Ti">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20050620.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=The Cruel Fate of Shaak Ti}}</ref>

[[File:SHAAK_edited.jpg|thumb|left|250x250px|Fan-made mash-up representing Shaak Ti's death, this time performed by Darth Vader.]]
Another version, filmed during additional photography at [[Shepperton Studios]],<ref name="DB" /> moved Shaak Ti's death to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Here, during [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], Darth Vader walks into her room, finds her meditating, and stabs her in the back.<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Saga">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', Disc 7, Star Wars Archives: Episode III: Kashyyk & Order 66: Deleted Scene: Anakin Kills Shaak Ti</ref> This scene was deleted from the film, though she is still described as in meditation during the Jedi Temple assault according to the novelization. Though not described first-hand, Vader asks the Gate Master [[Jurokk]] where Shaak Ti is.<ref name="ROTSn" /> This scene did, however, appear in one of Yoda's visions in the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season 6]] episode "[[Voices]]".<ref name="Voices">{{TCW|Voices}}</ref> In ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' a similar scene occurs, where Vader cuts her head off then in half.<ref name="LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]''</ref> In the current [[Canon]], this death has been acknowledged as Shaak Ti's official death,<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> as [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'']] was not included among the pre-2014 materials incorporated in the new continuity.<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref>

===Escape from Dagu===
Shaak Ti was originally slated to be the star of a novel called ''[[Escape from Dagu]]'' which was completed but never released. The novel, written by [[William C. Dietz]],<ref name="Escape from Dagu">''[[Escape from Dagu]]''</ref> was scrapped in favor of ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', due to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] greater public appeal. However, Shaak Ti's [[Battle of Dagu|mission]] and her confrontation with the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Artel Darc]] were referenced in the ''[[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:3:22]]'' and ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 116]]'', canonizing at least the basic plot of the story.

===The Force Unleashed===
During production of ''The Force Unleashed'', [[George Lucas]] confirmed to the game designers that the unused death scenes of Shaak Ti were non-canon, and they were allowed to use her in the game.<ref name="art">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> 

In an early draft of the story, Shaak Ti was on Alderaan, the guardian of the [[House of Organa/Legends|Royal Family]] and young Princess Leia. Starkiller manages to kill her, as one of the targets of the Great Jedi Purge, but is witnessed by Leia; this would require Starkiller to kill the young girl, being a witness, but proves unable to do it. This prompts Vader, and his second, secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], attack Starkiller. This betrayal triggered Starkiller's redemption, who, recovering ten years later, takes Shaak Ti's place in the royal family. This draft was rejected by Lucas.<ref name="art" />

In another early draft of the final version of the game, Shaak Ti retreated to Felucia in order to teach the [[Felucian/Legends|natives]] and bring balance to the Force. This was before the creation of her apprentice, Maris Brood, and her ambition to keep the Order alive.<ref name="art" /> 

In the N-Gage/iPhone version of ''The Force Unleashed'', Shaak Ti's death is portrayed differently. During her duel with Starkiller, she calls upon Felucia's plants to fight him. When Ti charges in attack herself, Starkiller uses the Force to make a Felucian carnivorous plant attack her. After several such attacks, Ti is eventually killed.
